purpose: Report saved calibration and a fixed new-mixture validation as separate stages; no production default change.

model.name: FrameMN10 strong, checkpoint 1
model.hash_scope: Local first-seen byte identity, not an upstream publisher-signed digest or proof of training-set independence.
model.timing_caveat: 40 ms is output spacing, not 40 ms latency or demonstrated physical onset/offset accuracy. Ten-second context and whole-file smoothing are noncausal.
model.checkpoint_license: No separate explicit checkpoint-weight license statement was verified. Internal research use only; no bundled weights or redistribution authorization.

runtime.dependency_note: Observed evaluation environment pins, not a claim of compatibility with other versions or platforms.

dataset.name: DCASE 2016 Task 2 synthetic office-sound mixtures
dataset.attribution: DCASE 2016 Task 2; test-package credits Grégoire Lafay, IRCCYN, Ecole Centrale de Nantes, France.
dataset.filename_ebr: Every calibration and new-mixture filename has literal EBR token 0; upstream dB-range prose is not reinterpreted.
dataset.license_discrepancy: The official-linked evaluation provider declares CC BY 4.0; the DCASE datalist says CC BY 3.0. The test-package README supplies task attribution but no resolving license statement.
dataset.use: Internal research evaluation only. Dataset license ambiguity remains unresolved; no audio is redistributed or relicensed.

selection_rule: Require each file false-positive support <= 2.0 seconds.
calibration.selection_scope: Only the two declared calibration files; no held-out score/metric reads or new inference during selection.
calibration.prior_exposure: Calibration recordings were previously exposed in the first fixed FrameMN pilot. This is a later calibration analysis, not a rewrite of the first fixed result.

new_mixture_selection.rule: Use test_2 and test_3 for each of literal EBR 0, NEC 2/poly 0 and NEC 4/poly 1; exact IDs selected before score inspection.
new_mixture_selection.independence_limitations: Per-mixture source IDs are unavailable. Independence from previously exposed test_1, between the four new mixtures, and from model pretraining is not established.
new_mixture_selection.manual_acoustic_qc: Not performed; annotation-based validation only. No causal acoustic explanation of misses is established.

preprocessing.input: Full 120-second mono 44100 Hz 16-bit PCM files, unchanged timeline.
preprocessing.resampling_output: Mono 16000 Hz little-endian float32, 1,920,000 samples per file.
preprocessing.resampling_caveat: The prior fixed FFmpeg PCM conversion is reused. The upstream demo uses librosa; resampler parity with librosa is not claimed.

decision.smoothing_scope: Each class independently over the concatenated 3000-frame full-file trace, before thresholding; never per inference chunk or after a class maximum.
decision.frame_support: Half-open intervals with edges 0.04*i seconds; adjacent accepted frames are contiguous support.
decision.broad_door_aggregation: Union of independently decoded Door, Knock, Slam, Sliding door, and Cupboard open or close support.
decision.physical_reference: Annotated knock plus doorslam only. Drawer and other events remain negative for this physical-door task.

separate_class_mapping.Slam: DCASE doorslam; cross-taxonomy mapping, not a dedicated Door slam class
separate_class_mapping.Door: DCASE knock plus doorslam, descriptive Door-only view

decision.diagnostic_scope: 0.20 uses the same saved 48 score tensors and unchanged median-nine decoder. No extra model calls or threshold selection.

research_fp_budget.scope: Broad union minus physical reference union for each primary-view file. Duration, not a false-alarm-count budget.
research_fp_budget.failure_policy: Retain and report every file; no retuning, replacement, additional threshold, fallback or model call.

metrics.segment: Half-open 1s bins; any positive overlap; pooled TP/FP/FN/TN and P/R/F1.
metrics.covered_reference: One count per annotated knock or doorslam with strictly positive overlap against union predicted broad-door support.
metrics.false_positive_support_seconds: Measure(predicted door union minus annotated door union).
metrics.negative_truth: Complete knock/doorslam annotations define physical-door-negative time only. Such time may contain other sounds or valid broad product-category sounds.
metrics.precision: TP / (TP + FP); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.recall: TP / (TP + FN); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.f1: 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.pooling: Sum confusion counts across files, then calculate rates; do not average per-file rates.
metrics.covered_reference_caveat: Any positive overlap counts a reference once; this is not a one-to-one event match, IoU threshold, event-count accuracy, or precise onset/offset measure.

zipformer_calibration.comparison: score >= threshold; release_ratio=1; original window support, merging and maximum-five-second splitting unchanged.
zipformer_calibration.qualification: Neither grid has an eligible operating point. No eligible Zipformer was selected for new-mixture validation; this is not a fair selected-model held-out comparison.
zipformer_calibration.limits: Grids, score calibration, label spaces and temporal support differ. Clip support can exceed a tight time budget even with zero false-positive one-second bins. No outside-grid or all-negative fallback was substituted.

execution.policy: One original run over all four fixed new mixtures; at most one load and 48 calls. Retain every result; no retry, retuning, fallback or Zipformer reexecution.

declared_resource_limits.scope: Declared run limits; address-space and RAM limits are not measurements of continuous peak usage.

limitations: Four synthetic office mixtures at one literal EBR token; no independent-replication or broad generalization claim.
All 12 doorslam references missed in new-mixture primary validation, despite satisfying the false-positive-time budget.
Lenient any-overlap coverage is not matched event accuracy, one-to-one detection or precise onset/offset accuracy.
Scores are not calibrated probabilities. The selected threshold lies at the calibration grid boundary.
40 ms output spacing is not latency; ten-second context and whole-file smoothing are noncausal.
No API integration/persistence, Windows, Vulkan, causal-streaming or production readiness acceptance.
No audio, transcripts, weights, class traces or full score matrices are redistributed.

public_package.test_scope: Pure standard-library aggregate arithmetic, pooling, protocol and reported-limit checks. No inference, audio decode, raw-score replay or model/frontend verification.
